title: Elodie and the Harvest
author: Edmund Almeida
blurb: August Kavanagh, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
